## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo test` passes (skip for translation/docs-only changes)
- [ ] UI strings go through i18n (`lang/en.json` is the base); comments and logs are in English
- [ ] No secrets or personal data in code, commits, or screenshots
- [ ] For behavior changes: verified in the real app, not only tests
